notes: Added core logic, API exposure, integration, and testing coverage for facade orchestration.

stories.title: Implement Core Orchestration Logic for Clinical Trials Flow

stories.title: Implement Core Orchestration Logic for Provider Detail Flow

stories.title: Expose Facade Methods via Tool Router Integration
stories.description: Integrate evaluate_care_facade methods into tool_router allowlist and dispatch flow, ensuring proper tool registration, invocation, and response handling within the Claude tool-use loop.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration with FastAPI Entry Point
stories.description: Ensure evaluate_care_facade is correctly wired into main.py service container and callable through API execution paths, validating end-to-end flow from chat request to facade orchestration.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for EvaluateCare Facade
stories.description: Create unit tests for facade methods and integration tests covering tool_router to facade to domain services, including success, validation failure, and external API error scenarios.
